worldcombat.skill.shadowball.summary: Hurl a living blob of shadow in a straight line: it deals special damage and may lower the target's Sp. Def by 1 stage, clinging to it for a moment when it does.
worldcombat.skill.shadowball.use.0: Precision single-target fire at mid range
worldcombat.skill.shadowball.use.1: Cling to a target and wear down its Sp. Def
worldcombat.skill.shadowball.use.2: Open from a distance before closing
worldcombat.skill.shadowball.description: It has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).
The ball flies straight at %1$s blocks per tick, up to %2$s blocks, with a %3$s block trace radius.
When sunder lands, the shadow clings to the target for %1$s and sheds about %2$s wisps; dense form is currently %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowball.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.shadowball.growth.0: From level %1$s the ball rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
On: ball power ×1.12 and trace ×1.15, but flight ×0.84, range −2 blocks, +4 ticks cooldown and +1 tick wind-up — a close-range hammer. Off: faster and longer but lighter, for mid-range poking.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it open fire from further away.
On: it ranks targets whose Sp. Def has not been lowered yet higher, since sunder is worth more on a clean target. Off: every target ranks the same, like an ordinary ranged attack.
